label: Rule
value: People working in their own business must pay themselves a calculated wage, at least what they would earn doing the same work for an unrelated employer and not below the tax authority's minimum for their category; it is taxed like wages, with withholding tax, tryggingagjald and pension contributions
basis: Minimum monthly calculated remuneration by category
note: A selection of the categories A to H in the tax authority's 2026 rules; the annual amount is 12 × the monthly one (for example ISK 5,664,000 a year in category E(9)).
